model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for several language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals.  There are four lines displayed, each representing a different model. The line representing “Llama-3B” is dark blue with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.39 at 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.89 at 2⁸. The line representing “Llama-3B + FT” is light green with triangular markers, starting at approximately 0.53 at 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.91 at 2⁸. The line representing “Llama-1B” is light blue with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.35 at 2⁰ and progressing to roughly 0.84 at 2⁸. Finally, the line representing “Llama-1B + FT” is pale green with triangular markers, starting at approximately 0.47 at 2⁰ and increasing to about 0.87 at 2⁸.
